# --- 0) Setup --- #

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Source setup script
project_dir <- "~/Documents/Postdoc/Projects/ASD-rarevar-annot/"
source(paste0(project_dir, "code/setup.R"))

# Set directory for analysis outputs
notebook_out_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "05_SynGO")
```

## 0.1 Load data

```{r load_data}
# ASD rare variant data
# df_asd_rarevar_zscore <- readRDS(file.path(analysis_dir, "00_data_format", "00_01_ASD-rarevar-stats.RDS"))

# SynGO data (v1.3)
syngo_dir      <- file.path(data_dir, "SynGO")
df_syngo_ontol <- read_xlsx(file.path(syngo_dir, "syngo_ontologies.xlsx"))

# SynGO analysis results (CC and BP domains)
syngo_summary_path <- file.path(analysis_dir, "05_SynGO", "05_01_syngo-asc-summary.xlsx")
df_cmu_cc <- read_xlsx(syngo_summary_path, sheet = "CC") %>% clean_names() %>%
    mutate(shortname = case_when(shortname == "integral"  ~ "integral component of",
                                 shortname == "extrinsic" ~ "extrinsic component of",
                                 TRUE                      ~ shortname))
df_cmu_bp <- read_xlsx(syngo_summary_path, sheet = "BP") %>% clean_names()
```


# --- 1) HotNet prep --- #

## 1.1 Define & label HotNet neighborhoods

```{r hotnet_neighborhoods}
# HotNet neighborhoods (GO IDs of member nodes)
cc_hotnet <- list(
    "Active zone"                 = df_cmu_cc %>% filter(orig_order %in% c(10, 11, 12, 15)) %>% pull(id),
    "Presynaptic membrane"        = df_cmu_cc %>% filter(orig_order %in% c(33, 36)) %>% pull(id),
    "Postsynaptic specialization" = df_cmu_cc %>% filter(orig_order %in% c(57, 59, 61, 62, 63, 64, 67)) %>% pull(id)
)
bp_hotnet <- list(
    "Presynaptic ion channels"  = df_cmu_bp %>% filter(orig_order %in% c(7, 8, 9)) %>% pull(id),
    "Postsynaptic organization" = df_cmu_bp %>% filter(orig_order %in% c(108, 109)) %>% pull(id)
)

# Long table of HotNet GO IDs (one row per node), 
df_hotnet_ids <- bind_rows(
    enframe(cc_hotnet, "hotnet_group", "go_id") %>% unnest(go_id) %>% mutate(domain = "CC"),
    enframe(bp_hotnet, "hotnet_group", "go_id") %>% unnest(go_id) %>% mutate(domain = "BP")
)

# label each df_cmu node with its hotnet_group
df_cmu_cc <- df_cmu_cc %>%
    left_join(df_hotnet_ids %>% filter(domain == "CC") %>% select(-domain), by = c("id" = "go_id"))
df_cmu_bp <- df_cmu_bp %>%
    left_join(df_hotnet_ids %>% filter(domain == "BP") %>% select(-domain), by = c("id" = "go_id"))
```

## 1.2 Extract HotNet gene sets

```{r hotnet_genes}
# SynGO annotations link gene (HGNC symbol) → GO term (id)
# For each HotNet neighborhood, list all genes annotated to any member GO node.
df_hotnet_genes <- df_syngo_ontol %>%
    dplyr::select(hgnc_symbol, id) %>%
    filter(!is.na(hgnc_symbol)) %>%
    separate_rows(hgnc_symbol, sep = ", ") %>%
    mutate(hgnc_symbol = str_trim(hgnc_symbol)) %>%
    inner_join(df_hotnet_ids, by = c("id" = "go_id")) %>%
    distinct(hgnc_symbol, hotnet_group, domain)

# Convert to list of gene vectors
hotnet_gene_lists <- df_hotnet_genes %>%
    split(.$hotnet_group) %>%
    map(~ pull(.x, hgnc_symbol) %>% unique())

cat("HotNet gene set sizes:\n"); print(map_int(hotnet_gene_lists, length))
```

## 1.3 Save HotNet gene lists

```{r save_hotnets}
saveRDS(hotnet_gene_lists, file.path(notebook_out_dir, "05_02_hotnet-gene-lists.RDS"))
```



# --- 2) Build HotNet trees --- #

`make_syngo_tbl_graph()` (pruned parent→child tree from a df_cmu domain subset)
lives in `code/functions/syngo-tree-graph.R`, sourced by `setup.R`.

```{r build_trees}
# BP tree (drop nodes with a non-numeric adj_z_all)
g_bp <- make_syngo_tbl_graph(
    df_cmu_bp %>% 
        filter(!is.na(as.numeric(adj_z_all))), 
    z_thresh = NULL
)

# CC tree
g_cc <- make_syngo_tbl_graph(df_cmu_cc, z_thresh = NULL)

# Save CC tree for figure
saveRDS(g_cc, file.path(notebook_out_dir, "05_02_CC-hotnet-graph.RDS"))
```


# --- 3) Plot: BP HotNet tree (supplement) --- #

```{r BP_hotnet, fig.width = 7.09, fig.height = 6.69}
layout_bp     <- ggraph::create_layout(g_bp, layout = "tree")
hotnet_levels <- c("Presynaptic ion channels", "Postsynaptic organization")

p_bp <- ggraph(layout_bp) +
    scale_linetype_discrete(name = "HotNet group",
                            limits = hotnet_levels,
                            guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1, label.theme = element_text(size = 7))) +
    # Edges: black into HotNet nodes, grey otherwise
    geom_edge_link(aes(color = to_is_hotnet, edge_width = to_is_hotnet)) +
    scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "grey50"), guide = "none") +
    scale_edge_width_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.4, "FALSE" = 0.2), guide = "none") +
    # Nodes: HotNet nodes get a thicker black border and are larger
    geom_node_point(aes(fill = adj_z, size = n_all, color = is_hotnet, stroke = is_hotnet), shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rev(brewer.rdbu(100)), na.value = "grey30",
                         limits = c(-5.76, 5.76), name = expression(Z[adj])) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "grey50"), guide = "none") +
    scale_discrete_manual(aesthetics = "stroke",
                          values = c("TRUE" = 0.5, "FALSE" = 0.15), name = "HotNet node") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 10), breaks = seq(0, 1500, 250), name = "N genes in path") +
    # Label HotNet nodes, direct children of the root, and strongly enriched nodes
    geom_node_text(data = . %>% filter(is_hotnet | parent_id == "SYNGO:synprocess" | adj_z > 2.8),
                   aes(label = str_wrap(shortname, 10)),
                   size = 1.8, repel = TRUE, max.overlaps = Inf,
                   segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey75",
                   box.padding = 0.5, min.segment.length = 0) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 10, clip = "off") +
    labs(title = "Synaptic process (BP) DNM enrichment") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
        plot.title             = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.position        = "bottom",
        legend.title.position  = "top",
        legend.key.height      = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        legend.key             = element_blank(),
        legend.title           = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.text            = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.box             = "horizontal",
        legend.justification   = "center",
        legend.panel.spacing.x = unit(3, "lines"),
        legend.margin          = margin(t = -5),
        plot.tag               = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

p_bp

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "supplement", "05_02_SynGO-BP-tree-HotNet-labels.pdf"),
       plot = p_bp, height = 6.69, width = 7.09, dpi = 300)
```


# DEPR

## Membrane HotNode gene extraction (exploratory)

```{r get_gene_lists, eval = FALSE}
## Extract membrane IDs
cc_membrane_ids <- df_syngo_ontol %>%
    filter(id %in% unlist(cc_hotnet) & shortname == "membrane") %>%
    pull(id)

## Write to excel spreadsheet
df_syngo_ontol %>%
    filter(parent_id %in% cc_membrane_ids | id %in% cc_membrane_ids) %>%
    dplyr::select(name, hgnc_symbol) %>%
    separate_rows(hgnc_symbol, sep = ", ") %>%
    group_by(name) %>%
    arrange(hgnc_symbol) %>%
    mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = row, names_from = name, values_from = hgnc_symbol) #%>%
    #write_xlsx(file.path(tables_dir, "2026.06.08_CC-membrane-HotNode-genes.xlsx"))

## Extract associated Zadj scores
df_cmu_cc %>%
    filter(id %in% (
        df_syngo_ontol %>%
            filter(parent_id %in% cc_membrane_ids | id %in% cc_membrane_ids) %>%
            pull(id)
    )) %>%
    dplyr::select(id, name, shortname, adj_z_all)
```
